compile.noOutput: Compile the project to see its output here.

history.name: Version name
history.saveHint: It is kept in the project's history (.libretex/history.git), apart from your Git repository if you have one. Automatic versions are saved too.
history.title: History
history.empty: No versions yet. They are saved every few minutes and after compiling; you can also save a named one.
history.pick: Pick a version to see what changed and restore it.
history.noChanges: This version changed no files (it was saved with a name).
history.diffHint: Changes of this version compared with the previous one.
history.addedHere: This file was added in this version.
history.deletedHere: This file was deleted in this version (restoring it removes it again).
history.binary: Binary file (image or other): the difference cannot be shown.
history.confirmProject: Every file of the project will be as in “{version}” again; files added later go to the trash.
history.confirmSafe: A version with what is there now is saved first, so you can undo it from the history.

export.noPdf: There is no PDF yet: compile with Ctrl+Enter.

projectSearch.title: Search in project
projectSearch.regexHint: Regular expression: in the replacement, $1, $2… insert the groups.
projectSearch.hint: Searches every text file of the project (not the ones produced by compiling). Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+F.

confirmReplace.one: {count} occurrence of “{text}” will be replaced with “{replacement}”
confirmReplace.other: {count} occurrences of “{text}” will be replaced with “{replacement}”

confirmDelete.one: {count} occurrence of “{text}” will be deleted (the replacement is empty)
confirmDelete.other: {count} occurrences of “{text}” will be deleted (the replacement is empty)

projectSearch.confirmNote: The files are changed on disk and the open ones are updated. There is no single “undo” for the whole replacement.

fileTree.title: Files
fileTree.deleteText: It will be moved to the system trash; you can restore it from there.

outline.title: File outline
outline.notTex: The outline is only available for .tex files.

editor.noFile: Open a file from the side panel.

pdf.notYet: Compile with Ctrl+Enter to generate the PDF.
pdf.location: It is saved in {path} (hidden project folder).
pdf.loadError: The PDF could not be shown.
pdf.missing: There is no compiled PDF yet. Compile with Ctrl+Enter.
pdf.syncToPdf: Go to the cursor's place in the PDF
pdf.syncHint: Double click in the PDF: go to the code
pdf.syncNoMatch: That place was not found in the PDF. If you changed the text, recompile.
pdf.syncOutside: That place in the PDF does not come from a project file.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyText: Create one from a template, open a folder with .tex files or import a ZIP (for example, exported from Overleaf).
projects.missingHint: The folder was moved or deleted. You can remove it from the list.
projects.trashed: “{name}” was moved to the trash. You can restore it from Trash.
projects.forgotten: “{name}” was removed from the list. Its files are still on disk.
projects.noMainFile: No .tex file with \documentclass was found; main.tex will be used.

renameDialog.title: Rename project
renameDialog.name: New name
renameDialog.hint: The folder on disk is renamed too.

trashDialog.title: Move to trash?
trashDialog.text: The folder “{name}” and all its contents will be moved to the system trash. You can restore it from there.

mainDialog.title: Choose the main file
mainDialog.text: Several .tex files with \documentclass were found. Which one is the main document?

packages.title: Packages

backendHelp.managed: Packages are installed with tlmgr in your home folder, without administrator rights.
backendHelp.official: Packages are installed with this installation's tlmgr.
backendHelp.pacman: This TeX Live's packages are installed with pacman (needs sudo). LibreTeX will tell you which pacman package to install, or you can install LibreTeX's TeX Live to manage them from here.
backendHelp.readOnly: This installation cannot be changed from LibreTeX. To manage packages from here, install LibreTeX's TeX Live.
backendHelp.none: Install TeX Live with pacman or with LibreTeX's assistant.
backendHelp.systemChosen: LibreTeX can't modify this TeX: its packages are installed outside the app (with pacman, on Arch). To install them from here, choose LibreTeX's TeX Live below.

install.packages: Installing what Spanish XeLaTeX needs: {package} ({done} of {total})
install.done: LibreTeX's TeX Live is installed. It is used for compiling from now on.
install.cancelled: Installation cancelled. Nothing was left installed.
install.explain: LibreTeX will download the official TeX Live installer from CTAN (a nearby mirror) and install the basic scheme plus what Spanish XeLaTeX, SyncTeX and latexmk need: about 80 MB to download and 210 MB on disk. With a good connection it takes one or two minutes.
install.where: It is installed in ~/.local/share/libretex/texlive, without sudo and without changing the system PATH. Other packages are installed when you need them from this manager.

packages.searchHint: Type a package name or what you are looking for (for example, «SI units» or «chinese»).

catalog.noCtan: No CTAN index: searching TeX Live only.

card.docsCtan: No local documentation: the package's CTAN page was opened.

preamble.added: \usepackage{{name}} was added to the main file's preamble.
preamble.noPreamble: The main file has no \begin{document}: there is nowhere to add it.
preamble.noProject: Open a project to add the package to its preamble.

card.updateFailed: Could not reach the TeX Live repository (offline?).
card.removeText: It will be removed from your TeX Live. Documents that use it won't compile until you install it again.

readOnly.notInTexlive: This package is not in TeX Live: it can only be installed by hand from CTAN.
readOnly.pacmanIntro: This TeX Live is managed by pacman. To install “{name}”, run in a terminal:
readOnly.noSudo: LibreTeX never runs sudo. When it finishes:
readOnly.noPacman: No pacman package that provides it was found. Install LibreTeX's TeX Live to install it from here.
readOnly.pacmanUpdates: It is updated with the system (sudo pacman -Syu).
readOnly.other: This TeX installation can't be modified from LibreTeX. Install LibreTeX's TeX Live to manage packages from here.

distribution.title: TeX distribution LibreTeX uses (to compile and for packages)
distribution.libretex: You install and update packages from LibreTeX, without sudo.
distribution.pacman: The one you installed with pacman; its packages are installed with pacman.
distribution.system: The one installed on the system; LibreTeX does not modify it.

installed.pacmanNote: With pacman they are installed by collections (texlive-…).
installed.unknown: LibreTeX can't tell which packages this TeX installation has. Search for a package to see if it is installed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Settings are saved in ~/.config/libretex/settings.json and apply at once.
settings.dictionaryHint: Words the spell checker accepts in every project. Add them by right-clicking an underlined word.
settings.dictionaryEmpty: You have not added any words yet.
settings.keymapHint: Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+J, Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I keep working.
settings.defaultSpellLangHint: Each project's language is changed in View → Project spelling.
settings.defaultCompilerHint: For new blank projects; templates bring their own.
settings.projectsDirHint: New and imported projects are created there; existing ones stay where they are.
settings.historyHint: Only if something changed. A version is also saved after each successful compilation.

errors.title: The action could not be completed
errors.invalidPath: The path is not valid or leaves the project folder.
errors.notFound: The file or folder does not exist.
errors.invalidName: The name is not valid: it cannot be empty, start or end with spaces, or contain “/” or “\”.
errors.alreadyExists: A project or folder with that name already exists.
errors.unknownProject: The project is no longer in the list.
errors.invalidZip: The file is not a valid ZIP or contains unsafe paths.
errors.trash: Could not move to the trash.
errors.io: Error reading or writing to disk.
errors.notText: The file is not text (or not UTF-8) and cannot be opened in the editor.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large to open in the editor.
errors.forbidden: That operation is not allowed here.
errors.network: The download failed. Check the internet connection.
errors.invalidSearch: The search is not valid: check the regular expression.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Projects you moved to the trash from LibreTeX. This is the system trash: what you restore or delete here also changes in your file manager.
trash.empty: There are no projects in the trash.

purgeDialog.title: Delete permanently?
purgeDialog.text: “{name}” and all its contents will be deleted forever. This cannot be undone.

conflict.changedText: Another program modified this file and you have unsaved changes in it. Which version do you want to keep?
conflict.deletedText: Another program deleted this file, but you have unsaved changes. You can keep them (saving will recreate the file) or close the file.
conflict.deletedToast: “{name}” was deleted from disk and closed.

viewer.imageUnavailable: Image preview is only available in the desktop app.
viewer.pdfLater: PDF figure preview will arrive with the PDF viewer (phase 6).

tex.missingLatexmk: latexmk, which LibreTeX uses to compile, was not found.
tex.missingEngine: {engine}, this project's compiler, was not found.
tex.installHint: On Arch Linux you can install TeX Live with:
tex.title: TeX distribution
tex.orManaged: Or, without sudo: install LibreTeX's TeX Live and manage packages from the app.

logs.notCompiled: The project has not been compiled yet.
logs.noLog: The engine did not write a log.

missing.resolving: Looking for the package that provides it…
missing.unknown: It is not known which package provides {file}.
missing.installed: It is already installed: compile again.

check.unclosedMath: Unclosed formula: “{close}” is missing before the end of the paragraph.
